full_page.content:
c. 1948, January 23
The following is a faithful transcription of the handwritten original by the Servant of God, Father Solanus Casey, O. F.M. Cap.
Saint Felix Capuchin Friary Huntington, Indiana Bles'd be God in all His designs! Jan. 23rd
God bless you Miss Krausman:
Many thanks for your prayer and for your kind favor just noted.
Thank God, while i have been "half down" for several weeks, still its nothing possitively serious. Of course we are hoping it will clear up so that I be able to do a little more toward so much waiting to be done.
Thank the Lord too: I am glad things seems brightening up for you and yours. It always comes right if only we have a little trustful confidence in the good God and our Blessed Mother Mary Immaculate.
Fr. Solanus, O.F.M.Cap.
